text: Hello, I'm here with you. Let's take one small step together. A little focus, a little rest. You're doing well.
description: An original tiny plush animated river-otter companion voice. A small soft rounded mid-high masculine cartoon register, light and sweet with a warm little nasal smile. Curious gentle bouncy phrases, cozy affectionate little squeaks in the vocal color while every word stays clearly spoken. Playful pocket-sized storybook creature. No heavy adult chest resonance, booming narration, gravel, whispering, singing or loud squealing.
